evidence: Walked instruction.md + hireops_rules.md line by line against solution/app. Every asked-for screen/role/flow has an implementation: (1) Views: staff nav builds Board, Conversations, Activity (app.js:87-91 buildViews); candidates get 'My applications' list with job title, team and candidate wording plus their conversations (threads.js:27,52-53,139; index.js:171-176 candidate read model using LABELS from seed). (2) Sign-in for all 10 accounts with Hireops!2026 seeded (db.js:61-66); 401 no session / 403 role (index.js:73-81); candidate 404 for others' applications (index.js:121-131, 326-333, 378-385). (3) Jobs: recruiter-only open job with title/team/HM from HM accounts/1-50 places (index.js:202-214; board.js:61-81). Add candidate name/email/source, bottom of Applied, email format + case-insensitive per-job duplicate reported at the field with typed values kept (index.js:216-233; board.js:41-60), candidate-account linking (index.js:225). (4) Board: six stages, one-step moves, reject with non-blank reason from any stage but Hired, reopen only to rejected_from (index.js:238-265); ordinary controls select+Move and Up/Down reorder, optional drag (board.js:208-244, 300-319); shared persisted order via position column (index.js:199-200, 296-318); Interview cap incl. bulk count and freed place (index.js:290-295); HM limits to own job and Interview/Offer/Hired (index.js:257-264); observer/candidate move nothing (mayMove index.js:326-333; board.js targets canWrite). (5) Concurrency: version per card, stale 409 names who via last activity line (index.js:241-245); optimistic move with snapshot put-back, reason shown, focus returned to the card controls (board.js:181-205). (6) Bulk all-or-none in board order (index.js:274-321 single .immediate() transaction, rank sort 284-288; board.js:285-290). Undo own latest move single or several, restores stage/place/reason, refused if any card version changed or Interview would overfill, single-use, superseded by later move; notes do not bump version (index.js:165-168, 348-373; board.js:291-299). (7) Card detail + internal notes, recruiter any / HM own job / observer read; unsaved note kept per user per browser (board.js:85-141; keep keyed by user id app.js:39-43; index.js:386-398). (8) Activity: every job open, add, move, reject (with reason), reopen, reorder, undo logged as readable lines; newest first; All jobs / one job filter (index.js:195-198, 211, 230, 266-271, 315-316, 366, 189; app.js:45-85). (9) Live updates: SSE 'changed' broadcast after any successful write including reads/messages (index.js:45-54, 102-107), client refresh + keyed in-place patching so open card, note draft, focus, scroll and drafts survive (app.js:130-164; board.js:321-341; threads.js:36-65,145-159). (10) Conversations: role access matrix (index.js:114-131); plain-text non-blank, line breaks kept; Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline; box cleared and refocused; failed send kept with message (threads.js:182-201); latest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count, scroll anchored (index.js:401-417; threads.js:110-131,160-175); arrival while scrolled up keeps place and shows 'N new messages' unread until visited (threads.js:145-159,176-181); per-person unread per conversation + nav total (index.js:132-139,157-162; app.js:115-121; threads.js:221); seen receipt on sender's latest message with observer excluded (index.js:143-150; threads.js:76-83). (11) Drafts per person+conversation in localStorage keyed by user id, survive switch/view/reload/session loss, re-sign-in as same person restores, others see none, send clears (app.js:38-43,187-195; threads.js:112,124,182,196). Candidate sign-in opens no conversation (threads.js:7). (12) Runtime contract: node /app/server.js -> bootstrap listens PORT on 0.0.0.0, /api/health answered before any DB work (bootstrap.js:18-24,43); DB_PATH honoured default /app/app.db, seed copied beside module and loaded once (db.js:9-10,61-62); solve.sh copies app to /app and ships no db.
